posts.title: The Pressure of Posting Often
posts.description: Ah, social media algorithms — the bane of my existence. People have said this before, since it’s so common, but social media algorithms tend to favor accounts that post often and consistently. Creators are expected to churn out content like factory-line workers nowadays. However, people don’t normally function that way. (If posting every day is your default, then you scare me).
